Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 21547 of 2024
Applicant :- Ghanshyam Prajapati

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Kumar Shahi,Rajeev Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Pramod Kumar Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.G.A. for the State.
Supplementary affidavit filed today by counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Ghanshyam Prajapati, with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 137 of 2024, under Sections- 376, 384, 504, 506 IPC and Section 67 of I.T. Act, Police Station- Khorabar, District- Gorakhpur.
There are allegations against the applicant that he has transferred obscene photographs of the victim to her husband and the elder brother of husband as a result of which her marriage broke down.

entities.text: Ghanshyam Prajapati vs State Of U.P. on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Court after hearing the learned counsels for the parties does not finds any ground for enlarging the applicant on bail at this stage.
The bail application is accordingly, rejected.

The trial court is directed to conclude the trial against the applicant as expeditiously as possible as per Section 309 Cr.P.C. (new Section 346 B.N.S.S.).
Order Date :- 9.5.2025 Rohit  Ghanshyam Prajapati vs State Of U.P. on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133926792/
